{{Quote|Straighten up, ''[&hellip;]'' Watch the Workers. Duplicate their stance.|translated=1|Borosiv, to Trevik in Quesoth Common Speak|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
'''Borosiv''' was a [[Quesoth]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]] and a member of the [[Circling of the First of the Red]] Quesoth caste, which [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] more of the Quesoth [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and advised the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], the Quesoth leader.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Death" /> the Quesoth [[Trevik]] became the [[Queen of the Red|Queen's]] [[bowlcarrier]], carrying a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for her while following her and Borosiv's litters.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

The [[Circling]] ordered the bowlcarrier to straighten up, follow the Workers' stance, and rise the [[Queen/Legends|monarch's]] bowl higher, which Trevik did. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]], he joined the Queen's escort and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with the Queen shortly after by her ally, the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between Esva and the Queen's forces and the [[Empire of the Hand]]. Borosiv spoke with a low voice.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Borosiv appeared in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
